component.name: Tether
component.summary: Bridge your iPhone to the Linux desktop

description.p: This is a community package of Tether. It runs the official Ubuntu 26.04 build from upstream's releases unmodified, with gtk-layer-shell and btmgmt from Debian added beside it.
Tether brings iPhone continuity features to Linux: messages and contacts, notification mirroring, file transfer, phone calls and AirPods, over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth LE.
The Bluetooth features need a one-time setup on the host system. This command prints the commands for your machine:
On a firewalled system, open TCP port 5134 and UDP port 5353 for the Wi-Fi route. Received files are saved to your Downloads folder.
Clipboard sync is not available in this package: it needs a Wayland protocol that compositors don't offer to sandboxed apps.
